items.mechanic: Wolves summoned by Beastmasters also summon 1 wolf on each kill, and every new wolf inherits that effect. End of turn: if the Beastmaster is engaged, one allied wolf touching it redirects the engaged unit and is healed for 10.

items.name: Thrill of the Hunt
items.mechanic: End of turn: wolves touching this Beastmaster gain 10 initiative. Whenever any wolf gets a kill, allies touching the fallen unit gain +2 damage for the battle.

items.name: Anointed Executioner
items.mechanic: Champions target the lowest-health enemy they are allowed to attack. Whenever a Champion is healed or gains positive stats, it gains twice as much.

items.name: True Form
items.mechanic: Druid's Shapeshift can now trigger an additional time.
items.trigger: endOfTurn; charge every 5 turns; max 2 uses

items.name: Ent's Visage
items.mechanic: After shapeshifting, attackers take 6 damage whenever they hit the Druid with a normal attack. Each time a Druid shapeshifts, its melee attacks gain an additional battle-long -2 speed debuff on hit.

items.name: Forest Friends
items.mechanic: End of turn: each Druid heals itself and all units Bonded to that specific Druid for 20. Whenever a Druid shapeshifts, it summons 2 wolves.

items.name: Crackling Mitosis
items.mechanic: When an allied elemental dies, blast its hex for 8. Elementals summoned by Elementalists can repeat that summon once after 4 turns.

items.name: Living Circuit
items.mechanic: End of turn: if any allied elemental is in range, this Elementalist gains 15 initiative once and all allied elementals in range gain 15 initiative.

items.name: Dine in Hell
items.mechanic: Start of turn: if a Knight is engaged at full capacity, it gains +5 armor until next turn. Whenever a Knight is hit by a normal attack while engaged at full capacity, it makes 1 normal attack back.

items.name: Sentinel Runes
items.mechanic: The first time an enemy moves off a Knight's hex, summon 2 elementals on that unit's new hex. If unused, this also triggers when the Knight dies.

items.name: Dogpile
items.mechanic: When Militia attack an enemy engaged by at least 3 allies, they strike 1 extra time.

items.name: Rat Behavior
items.mechanic: Start of turn: Militia gain +1 initiative for each other Militia touching them.
items.trigger: startOfTurn; scales per other touching friendly unit

items.name: Explosion Corpse
items.mechanic: Skeletons summoned by Necromancers spawn with +100 initiative. Whenever this Necromancer consumes a corpse, enemies adjacent to that corpse lose 1 armor and 1 damage for the battle.

items.name: Hemomancy
items.mechanic: Necromancers may spend 10 health instead of requiring or consuming a corpse for corpse-consuming abilities, as long as that would not kill them. Skeletons summoned by Necromancers heal allies on their own hex for 7 at the end of each turn.

items.name: Bolstering Light
items.mechanic: When a Priest heal brings its target to full HP, that target gains +1 speed and +1 damage for the battle. Otherwise, that target gains 40 initiative.

items.name: Mercy Before Dawn
items.mechanic: The first time each battle each allied unit within this Priest's range would die, it survives at 1 HP.

items.name: On the Hunt
items.mechanic: On attack: each Ranger sets its target initiative to 0. The first 2 times a Ranger kills a non-Fading enemy, consume the corpse and summon 1 wolf there.

items.name: Shadow's Embrace
items.mechanic: After attacking, Rangers move to the safest hex that still keeps an enemy in range. Ranger attacks against unengaged targets deal double damage.

items.name: War Drums
items.mechanic: Enhance 1 affects all allies on the chosen ally hex instead of one random ally.

items.name: Grave Vigor
items.mechanic: Whenever a Shaman applies a beneficial effect, that target leaves no corpse on death and summons 1 skeleton on death, gains 1 extra strike on its next normal attack if the effect was Enhance, and then ignores future beneficial effects and targeting from units with Grave Vigor.

items.name: Shield Drill
items.mechanic: Soldiers have -4 armor, but each ranged attack can deal at most 1 damage to a Soldier after all modifiers.

items.name: Spell Echo
items.mechanic: Each time this Wizard's Blast deals damage with Blast, repeat that Blast on an adjacent hex that hasn't been hit by any Blast in this chain.

items.name: Storm Rods
items.mechanic: Every 4 turns, each Wizard makes 4 extra strikes against a random enemy within its range. Wizard Blasts deal +1 damage per elemental on the target hex, and Wizards summon 1 elemental at the start of battle.
